io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.listeners

Class ArmorEquipListener

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.listeners.ArmorEquipListener
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    org.bukkit.event.Listener

    public class ArmorEquipListener
extends java.lang.Object
implements org.bukkit.event.Listener
    Applies SlimefunArmorPiece potion effects the instant a piece is equipped, so a player does not have to wait for the next periodic armor tick.

    This relies on Paper's com.destroystokyo.paper.event.player.PlayerArmorChangeEvent, which is NOT on our Spigot compile classpath, so the event is looked up and registered entirely by reflection. On a non-Paper server the class is absent, the listener never registers, and on-equip effects fall back to the periodic SlimefunArmorTask.
